title: Banding
description: Versioned mapping of a continuous column to ordered intervals. Carries the derivation method and the per-band evidence a reviewer needs (02 FR-97, FR-98, FR-99, FR-100, FR-101, §4.2).

column.description: The dataset column the boundaries were cut over; null on a Banding cut over an `expression` Factor's formula. Exactly one of `column` and `source_expression` is set (amended 2026-10-16, WK-690 Slice 4, RL-1615 DP-S4-1 and RL-1700 (c)).

source_expression.description: The text of the `expression` Factor's formula the boundaries were cut over, stored as written (02 §4.2). Null on a Banding cut over a column. Resolution applies the Banding only to an `expression` Factor whose `expression` parses to the same tree.

boundaries.description: Strictly increasing; bands are exhaustive over the observed range.

null_level.description: Label for nulls, or null to reject them.

band_stats.description: Evidence as of derivation, so a reviewer need not re-run anything (FR-99). Keyed by `level`, not `label`, and identical to profile.schema.json's one-way row: a band IS a level, 01 FR-61 already defines a level's statistics, and two definitions of the same numbers would disagree in the fourth digit with nothing to say which is right (amended 2026-08-15, WK-661 — this file said `label` while profile.schema.json said `level`, for the same statistics).

minimums.description: An empty band always fails regardless of this setting (FR-100).

invariants: exactly one of column and source_expression is set
